items.title: Bessent says Nvidia must ‘go outside the company’ to find new CEO
items.text: U.S. Treasury ‌Secretary Bessent also said Nvidia’s board and outside counsel needed to answer, within the next 10 days, questions about the company’s culture ‌of compliance with export restrictions

items.title: Penury-hit Kashmir artists seek official handholding
items.text: There are artists in Kashmir who are not able to pay school fees of their children or arrange ₹1 lakh to offer a decent burial to their deceased loved ones, says vocalist and music composer Ustaad Waheed Jeelani

items.title: Anbumani seeks pay hike for guest lecturers from Sept. 1
items.text: Anbumani demands immediate ₹5,000 pay hike for guest lecturers from Sept 1, plus further benefits and ₹50,000 target next year.

items.title: Respiratory illnesses rise in Gaza with worst to come as winter floods arrive, WHO says
items.text: Respiratory infections currently make up 11% of all consultations, with the WHO ‌expecting cold weather, flooding, overcrowded shelters and poor ventilation to push these numbers higher

items.title: Revanth urges Modi to expedite clearances for Telangana irrigation projects
items.text: Seeks Centre’s intervention to secure Maharashtra’s approval for Tummidihatti project; requests ₹5,000 crore under SASCI; invites PM to Khelo India Youth Games
